title: DataSlot
description: A named socket in an application that marketplace datasets can be bound into at configure time.

name.description: Slot identifier, unique within the application. Used in the data.<slot> expression namespace.

title.description: Display label shown in the configure flow.

description.description: Help text shown below the dataset picker.

required.description: Whether at least one dataset must be bound before deployment.

multiple.description: Whether more than one dataset may be bound to this slot.

accepts.description: Ordered list of accepted data interfaces. Order defines negotiation preference.

schema.description: Semantic constraints a bound dataset must satisfy.

InterfaceRef.description: Reference to a DataInterface in the form <name>/<version>, e.g. clickhouse-native/v1.

tables.description: Table constraints. Every constraint must be satisfied by a distinct dataset table.

name.description: If set, the constraint must be satisfied by the dataset table with this exact name. If omitted, any table qualifies.

columns.description: Columns that must exist in the matching table.

type.description: Required column type. See type compatibility rules in the specification.

items.description: Required element type. Only valid when type is 'array'; if set, the dataset column's element type must match.

dimensions.description: Required vector length. Only valid when type is 'vector'; if set, the dataset column's dimensions must match exactly.
